lastCompletedStory.title: Namespace and cap the setup config log instead of a fixed shared /tmp path

nextStoryContext: US-004 (Site 4 of 5, CAM-510, cam setup's config-pane viewer log) is fully implemented and verified DONE. src/commands/setup.ts's generated menu-pane bash script no longer produces the fixed shared literal /tmp/cam-config.log (previously at line 492's v|V branch: `tmux pipe-pane ... 'cat >> /tmp/cam-config.log'; tail -f /tmp/cam-config.log`). Three new exported helper functions replace it: buildConfigLogPathAssignment() emits bash lines that derive `$CAM_CONFIG_LOG` from one fixed, reused parent (`${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cam-cli-config-log`, mkdir -p'd) nested with the shell's own pid as the filename (`$$.log`) -- GOTCHA 2 satisfied: pid is a filename segment under a fixed parent, never a new top-level unique dir per run. This assignment plus `trap '<cleanup>' EXIT` are spliced into the menu script right after CAM_ORCH_PANE is declared, so the log path is established once per menu-script invocation and the cleanup fires on every exit path (both q|Q branches in either menu state, or any signal) via the trap rather than duplicated ad hoc before each `exit 0`. buildConfigLogCapCommand(logPathExpr, ceilingBytes = 200_000) returns a single-line bash command (`cat >> <path>; tail -c <ceiling> <path> > <path>.tmp 2>/dev/null && mv <path>.tmp <path>`) embedded inside the tmux `pipe-pane -o '...'` argument (the log is produced by a bash string tmux pipes into, so the cap is necessarily a shell construction, never TypeScript-side truncation -- verified by an explicit test assertion matching `/tail -c/` against the builder's own output). It appends first (preserving pipe-pane's `-o` toggle semantics, confirmed against the tmux man page: `-o` only opens a new pipe if none exists, letting `v`/`V` toggle the viewer, unaffected by this change) then immediately rotates the file back down to the ceiling via a tail-c-then-mv (keeps the trailing bytes of a still-growing file, never an arbitrary prefix truncation, and leaves no `.tmp` residue after the atomic mv). buildConfigLogCleanupCommand() returns `tmux pipe-pane -t "$CAM_CONFIG_PANE" 2>/dev/null; rm -f "$CAM_CONFIG_LOG"` (rm -f, never rm -rf per GOTCHA 4/CAM-507), wired into the EXIT trap. All three builders are exported so test/setup-config-log.test.ts (7 tests, all passing) runs the exact production snippets under REAL bash subprocesses (spawnSync), never a simulated string check, per the curated real-I/O test-quality invariant: (a) buildConfigLogPathAssignment -- asserts the emitted snippet contains 'cam-cli-config-log' and '$$.log' and excludes the old literal; and, run twice as two distinct bash subprocesses with TMPDIR redirected into a repo-local createTestTmpdir() scratch root (never real /tmp or the ambient $TMPDIR), proves two distinct pids produce two distinct paths under the identical fixed parent, and that the parent resolves inside the redirected scratch tree (proving TMPDIR was actually honored, not hardcoded); (b) buildConfigLogCapCommand -- fed 5x-ceiling stdin under real bash, asserts the resulting file size is >0 and <= the ceiling, that surviving content is the trailing bytes (tail semantics, not a truncated prefix), that no `.tmp` rotation artifact survives, that a small under-ceiling input passes through untouched, and that the command string itself matches /tail -c/; (c) buildConfigLogCleanupCommand -- asserts the log file is removed with no residue on menu exit, and is idempotent when the log was never created (viewer pane never opened). AC7's file-assert oracle (grep for the old literal absent, tail -c/head -c/truncate present) verified passing directly. GOTCHA 6 (budget): src/commands/setup.ts grew 884->954 lines (the story's notes anticipated an 885 ceiling breach); scripts/file-size-budget.json raised with a CAM-510 tracker ref prepended to `_ref` and staged in the same commit -- verified via `bun scripts/check-file-sizes.ts` passing. All gates verified green this dispatch: typecheck clean, full bun test 6089 pass / 0 fail (369 files), full bun run check:all spine green (lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps/test-tmpdir/skip-ratchet all ok), embed-vendor unaffected (no vendor/templates touched, ran clean as part of check:all regardless). Site 5 of 5 (per the CAM-510 issue spec) remains; branch is clean, committed, pushed by this dispatch's final step.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed tmux pipe-pane's -o flag toggles piping (opens a new pipe only if none already exists for that pane, otherwise stops it) -- unaffected by this story's change, which only rewrites the shell command string passed as the -o argument (now appending into a pid-namespaced, byte-capped path instead of the old fixed shared literal), not the pipe-pane invocation or its toggle semantics.
